prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with concussion after a parking lot collision. The patient had 25 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1184; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot with reported head impact and subsequent concussion symptoms. Over the course of care, the patient attended 25 visits for evaluation and management. The reported injury is consistent with the mechanism and force of the crash. Treatment followed a typical clinical course, with visit frequency decreasing as symptoms improved and the patient was progressively discharged from active care. Examination findings were mixed: several findings, including symptom-related and vestibular observations, support the diagnosis of concussion, while other neurological and imaging-related tests returned within normal limits. No prior injury to the same body region is known from the patient's history. Billing records were reviewed and show no duplicate or repeated charges for the same services. Overall, the clinical picture supports a diagnosis of concussion related to the collision, with recovery progressing as expected.
